identity_and_scope.principle: Argumentative social norms can be meaningful without making every Tellarite angry, hostile or identical.

misread_risks: Insult may be conventional engagement rather than escalation.
Complaint may be participation rather than refusal.
Strong disagreement does not automatically equal personal hostility.
communication_and_conflict.interpretation_rule: Measure hostility from context, consequences, explicit threats and relationship state—not sharp wording alone.

authority_and_status.rule: Do not invent titles, guilds, clans or political offices from argumentative style.

family_kinship_and_household.rule: No Tellarite marriage, household or inheritance model is locked without sources.

education_and_socialization.possible_norm: Debate competence may be socially valued.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Argument skill does not imply diplomacy, law, trade or any profession.

cross_cultural_interaction.professional_response: Treat sharp debate as context-sensitive; verify actual threat, refusal, offense or escalation.

ai_guardrails: Do not write every Tellarite as permanently angry.
Do not escalate relationship state solely from conventional insult/complaint.
Do not infer profession or political role from debate style.
Do not invent family/religious/legal customs to fill empty domains.
